description: NAS-04: deterministic hostile-transcript cases for NotesValidator. Each case is a stored transcript part (the only citable segments) and the reply a COMPROMISED or careless model might give; 'expect' is what the validator must keep. This says nothing about how a real model behaves (that eval set is gate G2). 'residual' cases document what the deterministic checks cannot catch.
